# Draft:Uttar Banga Maheshwari College Siliguri

----
Uttar Banga Maheshwari College (UBMC) is a private undergraduate college located in Siliguri, West Bengal, India. Established in 2022, the institution is affiliated with the University of North Bengal and offers courses in Commerce, Arts, Business Administration, and Computer Applications. The college aims to provide academic excellence combined with industry-oriented training to prepare students for the competitive job market.
Uttar Banga Maheshwari College was founded in 2022 with the objective of offering higher education opportunities to students in North Bengal. The college was established under the Maheshwari Educational Trust, focusing on bridging the gap between academia and industry through skill-based training and professional courses.
The college offers undergraduate and certification programs in various disciplines.

Campus and Facilities
Uttar Banga Maheshwari College has a modernized campus equipped with facilities to support academic and extracurricular development.
* Smart Classrooms: Equipped with multimedia projectors, audio-video tools, and Wi-Fi-enabled learning spaces.
* Sports Facilities: Includes football, cricket, volleyball, badminton, and indoor games like table tennis and carrom.
* Auditorium: Used for guest lectures, workshops, seminars, and training programs with state-of-the-art audio-visual equipment.
* Food Court: Serves freshly prepared multi-cuisine meals at affordable prices for students and staff.
* Computer Lab: Advanced lab with high-speed internet and updated software for IT-related coursework.
* Transport: Bus services are available for students from nearby areas in Siliguri.

Admissions
The college follows a merit-based admission process. Applicants must:
# Visit the official website.
# Register online and fill out the application form.
# Upload necessary documents and pay the application fee.
# Submit the application and await further instructions.
Source: [https://www.ubmcollege.com/ Official Website]
Placement and Career Opportunities
UBMC has a dedicated placement cell that collaborates with leading industries to provide job opportunities. The placement cell conducts:
* Mock Interviews
* Group Discussions
* Personality Enhancement Programs
* Aptitude Classes
* Pre-placement Talks
Key recruiters include Mahananda Food Products, Topsel Toyota, and Sati Dadi Agro Manufacturers Pvt. Ltd..
Affiliations and Recognition
* Affiliated with the University of North Bengal.
* Recognized for providing 100% placement assistance in certain fields.
